ioContract.inputsRaw: Current section content from invoking skill (or recent assistant output). methods.csv with columns category, method_name, description, output_pattern. agent-manifest.csv from {project-root}/_bmad/_config/. communication_language from config. User selection per round: 1-5 (method), r (reshuffle), a (list all), x (proceed), or direct feedback / multiple numbers.
ioContract.outputsRaw: Enhanced section content returned to invoking skill when user selects x; intermediate enhanced versions presented after each method; re-presentation of the 1-5,r,a,x prompt after each round; completion signal back to invoking skill.

logical.description: Receive or review the current section content that was just generated by the invoking prompt or process
Analyze conversation context — content type, complexity, stakeholder needs, risk level, and creative potential
Smart-select 5 methods that best match context, balancing foundational and specialized techniques across categories
Render the Advanced Elicitation Options block (numbered 1-5, plus r, a, x) in {communication_language} and prompt the user
Route on the user's selection: 1-5, r, a, x, direct feedback, or multiple numbers
Cases 1-5 — execute the selected method using its CSV description, adapting complexity to context, and produce an enhanced version of the section
Case r — pick 5 random but diverse methods across categories, with positions 1 and 2 chosen as the most likely useful for the current section
Case a — list all methods with descriptions in a compact table and allow the user to select any by name or number
Direct feedback case — apply the user's stated changes to the current section content
Multiple-numbers case — execute the chosen methods in sequence on the content
After showing the enhanced version, ask whether to apply the changes (y/n/other) and HALT until the user responds
Apply changes only on Yes; on No discard the proposed changes from memory; on other reply, follow the user's instructions
Case x — return the fully enhanced content back to the invoking skill and signal completion so the next section can proceed
